title: Babcock House Museum
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: The beautiful Greek Revival Cobblestone Babcock House Museum was built in 1848 near the shores of Lake Ontario along the Seaway Trail. Its cobblestone masonry, using weathered stone from Lake Ontario, is unique to this area of New York and most of these homes were erected prior to the Civil War. Step over the threshold and enter a world gone by.
